title: QuassLabs Data Cleanup input
description: Give the data utility one input (`input`) or many (`items`). Each input is the JSON body of the QuassLabs data_transform endpoint: pick an `operation`, then fill only that operation's fields. See the README or https://docs.quasslabs.com.

tool.title: Tool
tool.description: Only one tool in this Actor; leave it as is.

input.title: Input (single call)
input.description: The JSON body for one call. Ignored when `items` is non-empty. Example: {"operation": "csv_normalize", "csv": "Name;Email\nAda;ada@example.com", "output": "json"}.

items.title: Batch of inputs
items.description: Optional. A list of JSON bodies, one call each (max 1000 per run). One tool-call event is charged per item that succeeds; failed items are free. When set, `input` is ignored.
